title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: All of the marbles in Maria’s collection are red, green, or blue. Maria has half as many red marbles as green marbles and twice as many blue marbles as green marbles. Which of the following could be the total number of marbles in Maria’s collection?

solutions.text:
We can let \(r\) be the number of red marbles that Maria has. Since Maria has half as many red marbles as green, then we know that she has \(2r\) green marbles. Moreover, since she has twice as many blue marbles as green, then she will have \(2(2r) = 4r\) blue marbles. Adding these together gives us \( r + 2r + 4r = 7r, \) and so the answer must be a multiple of \(7.\) Among the answer choices, only \(28\) is a multiple of \(7.\)

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: If red is \(r\), then green is \(2r\)
Blue is twice green, so the total is a multiple of \(7\)
